name: Princess Takiyasha
source:
A hero who was held captive in Valhalla, the divine realm of infinite healing and infinite madness.

In her original world, she and her mother fought in a war to subjugate the surrounding areas.
However, she fell into a trap set by officials who saw her mother as a threat.

She fought bravely despite serious injuries, but was thrown into a portal of time and space created by her mother's magic.
